verdict.rationale: Brex AI docs describe agents that auto-enforce policy, escalate exceptions, follow up with non-compliant employees, and even file reimbursements, plus an MCP server enabling conversational natural-language interaction with expenses/policy — directly matching the story's intent. However, evidence doesn't show a live, pre-spend 'can I expense this?' conversational check or explicit receipt-chasing dialogue, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI claims. missing for 10: hands-on evidence of proactive pre-spend policy Q&A, explicit receipt-chasing conversation examples, and independent verification of the AI agent's conversational enforcement in practice.
